points.description: Names and describes two valid challenges of mobile routing versus fixed wired networks (e.g. adaptation to dynamic topology/nodes joining and leaving; security such as interception/injection of packets in wireless; medium access control problems such as hidden, exposed, near/far terminals and collisions/interference). Each challenge needs a name plus a correct description. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one challenge is correctly named and described, or if two are named but only one is adequately described.

rubric.notes: Full mark: two valid challenges, each named and correctly described. Half: only one fully correct challenge (or two named with only one described). No marks: no valid challenge, or generic statements not specific to mobile/wireless routing.
